Summary: As a patient starting intake, I want to be greeted by a conversational assistant that explains its role and captures my consent, so that I understand how the AI intake works before sharing information (AC-037.1)
Description: Validates that a welcome message with an interactive consent card appears within 2 seconds of session start.
Step Action: Patient opens the intake link or approaches an idle tablet
Step Expected Result: A welcome message appears within 2 seconds, explaining the intake purpose and displaying an interactive consent card

Summary: Persistent non-diagnostic disclaimer remains visible throughout the conversation (AC-037.2)
Description: Validates that the disclaimer banner persists across every conversation state.
Step Action: Patient views the chat at any point in an active conversation
Step Expected Result: A persistent banner states the assistant does not provide medical diagnoses or treatment recommendations

Summary: Consent gating blocks input until terms are accepted (AC-037.3)
Description: Validates that message input is disabled while consent is pending.
Step Action: Patient attempts to type or send a message before accepting consent
Step Expected Result: Input remains disabled and the patient is instructed to accept the terms before continuing

Summary: Conversation viewport auto-scrolls to latest content while keeping the disclaimer visible (AC-037.4)
Description: Validates viewport behavior as new messages or cards are added.
Step Action: New messages or cards are added to the conversation
Step Expected Result: The viewport moves to the latest message while the disclaimer remains visible

Summary: Patient declining consent is redirected to clinic staff and the session is locked (AC-037.ALT.1)
Description: Validates the decline path from the consent card.
Step Action: Patient opts out on the consent card
Step Expected Result: The assistant directs the patient to clinic staff and locks the chat session

Summary: Service-unavailable fallback message on session load (AC-037.EX.1) — AMBIGUOUS: "without exposing system errors" has no defined negative list (see testability review)
Description: Validates the fallback message shown when the chatbot service is unavailable at load.
Step Action: The chatbot service is unavailable when the session loads
Step Expected Result: A non-technical fallback message directs the patient to the receptionist; exact prohibited-content list is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: In-chat identifier prompt with format validation (AC-038.1)
Description: Validates the MRN/phone identifier card and its format validation.
Step Action: Consent has been accepted and the assistant begins identification
Step Expected Result: An in-chat card requests the patient’s MRN or registered phone number with format validation

Summary: OTP widget appears with masked destination and resend countdown (AC-038.2) — MISSING DATA: countdown duration unstated (see testability review)
Description: Validates the OTP entry widget after a valid identifier is submitted.
Step Action: A valid identifier is submitted and an OTP is dispatched
Step Expected Result: A six-digit entry widget appears with a masked destination and a resend countdown; exact countdown duration is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: Successful OTP verification continues the same conversation without reload (AC-038.3)
Description: Validates the verified state transition after correct OTP entry.
Step Action: The patient enters the correct OTP
Step Expected Result: The widget changes to a verified state and the assistant continues in the same conversation without a page reload

Summary: OTP resend restarts the countdown, subject to a session resend limit (AC-038.ALT.1) — MISSING DATA: resend limit value unstated (see testability review)
Description: Validates the resend flow after the countdown expires.
Step Action: The resend timer has expired and the patient requests another code
Step Expected Result: A new OTP is sent and the timer restarts, subject to a session resend limit; exact limit is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: Verification locks out after five consecutive failed OTP attempts (AC-038.EX.1)
Description: Validates the lockout path after repeated OTP failures.
Step Action: Five consecutive OTP attempts fail
Step Expected Result: The widget locks and directs the patient to clinic staff

Summary: Returning patient sees structured history cards for allergies, medications, and chronic conditions (AC-039.1)
Description: Validates that history review renders structured cards with confirm/update actions.
Step Action: An authenticated returning patient with existing records begins history review
Step Expected Result: The assistant displays structured cards for allergies, medications, and chronic conditions, each with confirmation and update actions

Summary: Single-tap history confirmation advances to symptom intake (AC-039.2)
Description: Validates the confirm action on a history card.
Step Action: The patient selects "Looks Correct" on a displayed history card
Step Expected Result: The card shows a confirmed state and the assistant proceeds to symptom intake

Summary: Patient-reported history update is captured (AC-039.3) — MISSING DATA: destination/review mechanism for the captured change is unspecified (see testability review)
Description: Validates that a plain-language history change is captured.
Step Action: The patient chooses to update history and provides a plain-language change
Step Expected Result: The change is captured as patient-reported information for review; the exact review destination/mechanism is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: No-recorded-history state offers confirm-none or add-information options (AC-039.4)
Description: Validates the empty-history state of the history card.
Step Action: No allergies or medications are recorded for the patient and the history card renders
Step Expected Result: The assistant clearly states no records are on file and offers options to confirm none or add information

Summary: Chief-complaint extraction captures core clinical slots (AC-040.1) — MISSING DATA: slot list is open-ended ("such as"), not a closed schema; matches EPIC-011 Dependency #2 (see testability review)
Description: Validates extraction of complaint, location, onset, duration, and context from a free-text description.
Step Action: An active intake conversation and the patient describes a concern
Step Expected Result: The assistant captures relevant details such as complaint, location, onset, duration, and context using non-diagnostic language; the authoritative slot schema is unresolved pending Dependency #2

Summary: Adaptive follow-up asks one question at a time (AC-040.2) — AMBIGUOUS: "concise" and "contextually relevant" are unbounded (see testability review)
Description: Validates single-question pacing when clinical details are incomplete.
Step Action: Required clinical details are incomplete and the assistant generates the next turn
Step Expected Result: The assistant asks one concise, contextually relevant question at a time; exact bounds on "concise"/"relevant" are unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: Quick-reply controls are offered with free-text fallback (AC-040.3) — AMBIGUOUS: "where appropriate" is unbounded (see testability review)
Description: Validates quick-reply rendering alongside free-text access.
Step Action: A structured value is requested and the prompt renders
Step Expected Result: The patient can respond using quick-reply controls while retaining access to free text where appropriate; the exact free-text-eligible prompt set is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite

Summary: Assistant declines to diagnose and redirects to information-gathering framing (AC-040.4)
Description: Validates the non-diagnostic guardrail when a patient asks for a diagnosis.
Step Action: The patient asks the assistant for a diagnosis or treatment recommendation
Step Expected Result: The assistant explains it is collecting information for the healthcare provider and does not provide diagnostic or treatment advice

Summary: Typing indicator appears during processing (AC-040.5, part 1 of 2 — COMPOUND, split from duplicate-submission prevention, see testability review)
Description: Validates the typing indicator while a patient message is being processed.
Step Action: A patient message is submitted and the assistant is processing it
Step Expected Result: A typing indicator appears

Summary: Duplicate and out-of-order submissions are prevented (AC-040.5, part 2 of 2 — COMPOUND, split from typing indicator, see testability review)
Description: Validates that rapid or out-of-order message submissions are not double-processed.
Step Action: A patient message is submitted and the assistant is processing it, and the patient submits again before a response arrives
Step Expected Result: Duplicate and out-of-order submissions are prevented

Summary: Guided clarification on ambiguous input does not repeat the same prompt more than twice (AC-040.ALT.1)
Description: Validates the clarification-attempt cap for ambiguous patient input.
Step Action: The patient provides minimal or ambiguous information
Step Expected Result: The assistant offers guided clarification without repeating the same prompt more than twice

Summary: Off-topic input is redirected and excluded from the clinical payload (AC-040.ALT.2)
Description: Validates handling of unrelated patient input.
Step Action: The patient enters unrelated content
Step Expected Result: The assistant politely redirects to intake and excludes the content from the clinical payload

Summary: Every patient message is evaluated by the deterministic red-flag engine (AC-041.1) — AMBIGUOUS: "before or in parallel with LLM processing" is an internal ordering claim, not black-box observable; rewritten here to the observable guarantee (see testability review)
Description: Validates that 100% of red-flag test messages trigger escalation regardless of internal processing order.
Step Action: Any patient message is submitted during an active chat session
Step Expected Result: A deterministic red-flag engine evaluates the message, and every red-flag test message results in escalation being triggered

Summary: Confirmed red-flag match dispatches an immediate escalation event to the clinician/staff dashboard (AC-041.2) — MISSING DATA: exact latency bound unstated; also an OPEN QUESTION in the master PRD (NFR-002)
Description: Validates that escalation dispatch reaches the staff dashboard after a confirmed match.
Step Action: A patient message matches a validated red-flag criterion
Step Expected Result: An emergency escalation event is sent to the clinician or staff dashboard; exact maximum latency is unresolved (NFR-002, OPEN QUESTION)

Summary: Emergency takeover displays a high-contrast directive message (AC-041.3)
Description: Validates the emergency takeover UI state.
Step Action: A red flag is detected and the user interface updates
Step Expected Result: A high-contrast message directs the patient to notify clinic staff or contact emergency services immediately

Summary: Chat is locked during an active emergency takeover (AC-041.4)
Description: Validates that input is disabled during emergency takeover.
Step Action: An emergency takeover is active and the patient views the interface
Step Expected Result: Free-text input and interactive controls are disabled

Summary: Emergency message contains no diagnostic claim or speculation (AC-041.5)
Description: Validates the content of the emergency takeover message itself.
Step Action: An emergency message is displayed and the patient reads it
Step Expected Result: The content contains no diagnostic claim or speculation

Summary: Completion card confirms secure submission with next-step instructions (AC-042.1)
Description: Validates the completion card content and trigger.
Step Action: Required history confirmations and symptom slots are complete and the intake concludes
Step Expected Result: The assistant displays a completion card confirming secure submission and providing next-step instructions

Summary: Session inputs are disabled once intake completes (AC-042.2)
Description: Validates that the interface locks on entering INTAKE_COMPLETE.
Step Action: The session enters INTAKE_COMPLETE and the completion card appears
Step Expected Result: Input fields, attachments, and quick replies are disabled

Summary: Internal triage levels and clinical notes are never exposed to the patient (AC-042.3)
Description: Validates that clinical artifacts stay hidden from the patient’s own transcript view.
Step Action: The patient reviews the completed conversation and messages are displayed
Step Expected Result: Internal triage levels and generated clinical notes are not exposed

Summary: Structured note generation and EHR staging run asynchronously after completion (AC-042.4)
Description: Validates that the completion event does not block on downstream processing.
Step Action: The session completes and the completion event is recorded
Step Expected Result: Structured note generation and EHR staging run asynchronously, without blocking the patient-visible completion state

Summary: Background processing failure flags the transcript for staff review without altering the completion message (AC-042.EX.1)
Description: Validates the fallback behavior when async processing fails or is delayed.
Step Action: Background processing fails or is delayed after the patient views the completion state
Step Expected Result: The completion message remains unchanged and the transcript is flagged for staff review

Summary: Completion purges all local session data (AC-043.1) — MISSING DATA: completion timeout duration unstated; matches EPIC-011 Dependency #5 (see testability review)
Description: Validates the data purge triggered by completion or the finish action.
Step Action: The tablet is in INTAKE_COMPLETE and the configured completion timeout expires or the patient selects the finish action
Step Expected Result: Chat history, local storage, session data, DOM nodes, and cookies are purged; exact timeout duration is unresolved pending Dependency #5

Summary: Tablet reloads to a clean welcome state after purge (AC-043.2)
Description: Validates the post-purge restart state.
Step Action: The purge completes and the tablet reloads
Step Expected Result: The tablet displays the initial welcome state with no previous patient information

Summary: Idle sessions show a countdown warning before privacy reset (AC-043.3) — MISSING DATA: idle threshold duration unstated; matches EPIC-011 Dependency #5 (see testability review)
Description: Validates the idle-warning state ahead of an abandonment purge.
Step Action: An intake session has no activity for the configured idle threshold
Step Expected Result: A countdown warning explains that the session will reset for privacy; exact idle threshold is unresolved pending Dependency #5

Summary: Abandonment purge clears local data; server-side drafts retained only via an approved staff process (AC-043.4) — AMBIGUOUS: "approved staff-accessible processes" names no actual mechanism or role (see testability review)
Description: Validates the data-handling outcome when an idle session times out.
Step Action: The idle countdown expires and the session resets
Step Expected Result: Local conversational data is cleared and any server-side draft is retained only through an approved staff-accessible process; the exact mechanism/role is unresolved pending the testability review’s suggested rewrite
